description: This file defines a class TuiStreamAssembler for managing streaming text data, including extracting, updating, and finalizing text streams, with functions for handling text blocks and boundary conditions.

classes.name: TuiStreamAssembler
classes.description: A class for assembling and managing streaming text data, including handling multiple runs, updating states, and finalizing output.

methods.name: getOrCreateRun
methods.description: Retrieves existing run state or creates a new one for a given run ID.

methods.name: updateRunState
methods.description: Updates the state of a run based on incoming message, including handling boundary conditions and composing display text.

methods.name: ingestDelta
methods.description: Processes incremental updates (deltas) for a specific run, returning updated display text if changed.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes a run, producing the final display text, and cleans up the run state.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Deletes a run's state, effectively dropping it.
